text: I see you're in severe pain; to help me narrow this down, have you noticed any fever or chills along with the nausea and vomiting? Also, when you urinate, do you experience burning or a strong urge to go frequently?

speaker: Patient
text: 17-year-old female. The patient presents with a 5-day history of severe abdominal pain and cramping, accompanied by nausea and vomiting. speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Pyelonephritis secondary to a urinary tract infection, likely ascending from a urethritis or cervicitis given the sexual history. REQUEST IMAGES: Renal_Ultrasound.
